{{Top}}
'''Vanilla''' was a type of food flavoring. The [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] gave his apprentice [[Sariss]] a sweet made from vanilla-flavored syrup as a gift while the pair were discussing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> [[Zwil]], another flavoring substance, tasted like a combination of vanilla and cinnamon.<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> Members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] extruded a substance from their skin which smelt of vanilla<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> and the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] species bonding pheromone also shared the smell.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
